name: fixed_is_not_mated
why: ENTRIES Z-D3, Z-D4, Z-D5. The state of an assembly said HOW MANY mates a component has, not WHICH; it did not say whether a component is a sub-assembly, hidden or transparent; and fixing or freeing a component was not possible. Measured on 27/9/2026 (probe0089 zd345): GetMates gives IMate2 with the type (swMateType_e); the transparency is in MaterialPropertyValues[7]; FixComponent/UnfixComponent on the selected component work in both directions, even on the first component, which SOLIDWORKS fixes by itself.
defect_caught: A mate read with the wrong type (the enum by number); a component that was fixed and on re-reading is still free (FixComponent is void: it says nothing); the first component, fixed by SOLIDWORKS, that cannot be freed; a sub-assembly or a hidden component that the state does not tell apart.

expect.why: Z-D3: the type of the mate by NAME, not only the count
Z-D4: the base is a part
Z-D4: no appearance of its own on the component, so not transparent
re-read with IsFixed: FixComponent answers nothing
the base (fixed by SOLIDWORKS) and the cover
the first component is fixed by SOLIDWORKS by itself
and it can be freed like one fixed by hand (measured)
